# R internal CO2 dataset
```{r}
data("CO2")
```

# Brief description of CO2 dataset using help
The data consists of CO2 uptake measurement of six plants from Quebec and six plants from Mississippi.
The plants were put in several levels of ambient CO2 concentration.
Half of the plants from each location were chilled before the experiment.

# Average and median CO2 uptake of plants from Quebec and Mississippi
The average and median CO2 uptake of plants from Quebec and Mississippi were calculated using the following script:
```{r}
# Average CO2 uptake of plants from Quebec
mean(CO2[CO2$Type == "Quebec", "uptake"])

# Median CO2 uptake of plants from Quebec
median(CO2[CO2$Type == "Quebec", "uptake"])

# Average CO2 uptake of plants from Mississippi
mean(CO2[CO2$Type == "Mississippi", "uptake"])

# Median CO2 uptake of plants from Mississippi
median(CO2[CO2$Type == "Mississippi", "uptake"])
```

# "airway" example data from Bioconductor
After Bioconductor package was installed, the "airway" dataset was loaded using the following script:
```{r, message=FALSE}
# Load airway dataset
library(airway)
data("airway")
```

To address the questions on the "airway" example data, the following script was used:
# Number of genes expressed in each sample
```{r}
colSums(assay(airway) > 0)

# Number of genes not expressed in any sample
sum(rowSums(assay(airway)) == 0)
```
